speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Relocating the wind park would allow us to continue using these fishing grounds.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: For our communities, this would protect our traditional fishing practices and livelihoods.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: But moving the wind park does not make its environmental impact disappear.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: A new location could affect different marine habitats and species.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Some alternative areas may contain important breeding or feeding grounds for marine life.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: Relocating the project would also require new planning, construction and infrastructure.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: This would significantly increase the cost of the project and delay energy production.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Relocation would protect the fishing communities, but it risks transferring the environmental and economic impacts to another location.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The decision benefits SDGs 1, 2 and 8 in the current fishing area, but creates new environmental risks and additional costs elsewhere.
